discovery: An elderly pilgrim sits at a fork in the road, staring at a torn map with no idea which way leads to Northfield.

victim_data.dialogue: Oh, thank the stars - could you help me find my way?
thanks: Bless you, traveler. The road is kinder with company like yours.
after: I do hope I haven't slowed you down too much.

choices.label: Guide Them
choices.outcome: You offer to walk with them. The pilgrim tucks their torn map away and falls in step beside you, telling stories of the shrines they've visited along the way.

choices.label: Point the Way
choices.description: Give them directions and move on
choices.outcome: You point out the northern road and describe the landmarks to watch for. The pilgrim thanks you and sets off, map in hand.

choices.label: Walk On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - not your concern
choices.outcome: You leave the pilgrim squinting at their map and continue on your way.
